skills.name: giskard-to-collibra
skills.description: Export Giskard scan results into Collibra AI Governance. Use this whenever the user asks to export, push, sync, or import a Giskard scan, agent, or project (e.g. "Zephyr") into Collibra, or to update Collibra AI Governance assets, monitors, or Quality-tab metrics from Giskard. Also use it when the user asks to "retrieve the latest scan of a project and send it to Collibra", even if they do not say the word "export".
headings: Giskard to Collibra export
One-time setup
Run the export
Notes
skills.description_zh: 将 Giskard 扫描结果、代理或项目导出同步到 Collibra AI Governance，更新治理资产、监控和 Quality 指标，包括获取最新扫描后发送。

skills.name: rag-evaluator
skills.description: Generates tailored giskard.checks evaluation suites for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems. Use whenever a user describes a Q&A bot grounded in documents, a knowledge-base chatbot, a retrieval system, or wants to evaluate answer groundedness, faithfulness, hallucination, retrieval quality, citation accuracy, or out-of-scope handling. Triggers on phrases like "evaluate my RAG", "test my retrieval", "check groundedness", "build a RAG eval suite", "eval my chatbot answers from docs", "test if my agent hallucinates", "check if my answers are faithful to the sources", or any evaluation task involving an agent that answers from documents, FAQs, wikis, or a knowledge base. Use this skill even when the user does not explicitly say "RAG" but describes an agent grounded in documents. For adversarial / red-teaming evaluation, use the `scenario-generator` skill instead. This skill focuses on quality, not safety.
headings: Giskard RAG Evaluator
Step 1: Gather Context (do not skip)
Step 2: Choose Automatic Scan, Hand-Written Suite, or Both
Step 3: Map Inputs to Eval Dimensions
Step 4: Generate or Load Test Questions
Step 5: Pick Checks (cheap → expensive)
Step 6: Build Scenarios and the Suite
Canonical code structure
1. Configure the LLM generator used by Groundedness, AnswerRelevance, Conformity, LLMJudge.
Name a current model explicitly; the built-in fallback is a legacy one.
A mid-tier model is plenty: judging is much cheaper than generation.
2. Define the SUT (System Under Test). The user replaces this stub.
IMPORTANT: parameter name MUST be `inputs` (and optional `trace`) for giskard injection.
Any other required parameter raises TypeError when the scenario is built.
3. Test data, either loaded from the user's Q&A set, or synthesized from the KB.
4. Build scenarios.
5. Compose suite.
6. Run with the user's agent as target.
skills.description_zh: 为基于文档、FAQ、Wiki 或知识库回答的 RAG 系统生成定制 giskard.checks 评估套件，检查依据性、忠实度、幻觉、检索质量、引用准确性和范围外处理；关注质量，对抗安全测试交由 scenario-generator。

skills.name: scenario-generator
skills.description: Generates tailored giskard.checks test scenarios and suites for AI agents. Use when user describes their agent and fears, asks to "create scenarios", "test my agent", "generate checks", "evaluate my chatbot", "red-team my AI", or wants to build adversarial test cases for LLM-based applications.
headings: Giskard Checks Scenario Generator
Step 1: Gather Context (do not skip)
Step 2: Map Fears to Attack Surfaces
Step 3: Select Checks (cheap → expensive)
Step 4: Write the Code
1. Configure the LLM generator used by the judges and UserSimulator.
Name a current model explicitly; the built-in fallback is a legacy one.
2. Define the SUT (System Under Test) -- user replaces this
IMPORTANT: parameter names must be `inputs` (and optional `trace`); any other
required parameter raises TypeError when the scenario is built.
IMPORTANT: always add type hints so the user knows the expected format
3. Define scenarios (inputs only -- no outputs needed)
4. Compose suite
5. Run -- pass the SUT as target here
Critical rules
Step 5: Run, Review, Harden
Step 6: Offer the Automated Scan as a Complement
Output Format
skills.description_zh: 根据 AI 代理描述与担忧生成定制 giskard.checks 场景和测试套件，支持聊天机器人评估、红队及 LLM 应用对抗案例。
